title: Traveller Club Standing and the Uplift on a Voucher (Air Ticket Fare Brands)
content:
What the traveller club card adds to the value the booking's lines leave, under the Air Ticket Fare Brands terms, follows the tier held and how long the card has stood. Two records are read from the traveller's **Wanderlane Traveller Club** membership: the active club card and the tier it names, and the date that card was enrolled. The long-membership term is 120 months, counted from the enrolment date of the active card.

| Active club card held | Standing of the card | Uplift added to the value the booking's lines leave |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Platinum, Titanium or Ambassador | Enrolled at or beyond 120 months | 0.08 |
| Blue, Silver or Gold | Enrolled at or beyond 120 months | 0.05 |
| Any tier | Enrolled within 120 months | 0.02 |
| No active card of any tier | Not in question | No uplift is added |

In terms: where the traveller holds an active traveller club card of the Platinum, Titanium or Ambassador tiers and the card was enrolled at or beyond the long-membership term, the senior-member uplift, being 0.08, is added as an uplift to the value the booking's lines leave. Where the traveller holds an active traveller club card of the Blue, Silver or Gold tiers and the card was enrolled at or beyond that term, the member uplift, being 0.05, is added as an uplift to the value the booking's lines leave. Where the traveller holds an active traveller club card of any tier and the card was enrolled within that term, the entry-member uplift, being 0.02, is added as an uplift to the value the booking's lines leave. Otherwise no uplift is added to the value the booking's lines leave.

**Either side of the term.** A card that has stood exactly 120 months is at the long-membership term, and takes 0.08 or 0.05 according to its tier. A card that has stood 119 months is within the term, and takes 0.02 whatever its tier. On hypothetical standings: an active Titanium card enrolled 132 months ago takes 0.08; an active Silver card enrolled 132 months ago takes 0.05; that same Titanium card, had it been enrolled 96 months ago, takes 0.02.

**What the figures mean, on a hypothetical amount.** Each figure in the table is a proportion of the figure the uplift is added to, and not an amount in cents. On a hypothetical value the booking's lines leave of 500.00 US dollars, an uplift of 0.08 adds 40.00 US dollars, giving 540.00 US dollars; an uplift of 0.05 on that same hypothetical 500.00 US dollars adds 25.00 US dollars, giving 525.00 US dollars.
